title: Whale's Tail Parasail Miramar Beach
specs: Minimum age to parasail is 6 years of age.

PHYSICAL RESTRICTIONS: If you are PREGNANT, have a HEART CONDITION, BAD BACK or any other physical conditions that will be aggravated by potential rough conditions on the ocean or the parasail flight.
Minimum total weight for a flight is 200 lbs. and Maximum weight is 450-500 lbs (204kg).
People who are at higher risk categories such as those over 65 years old and people of any age who have serious underlying medical conditions should not participate.
We require a child to be at least 6 years old to parasail.
The minimum combined weight in the chute at one time varies on wind conditions but will never be less than 160 pounds.
The maximum weight per flyer is 250 pounds.
A maximum number of three flyers will be permitted at one time with a max weight of 450 pounds combined.
